tagline: Send invoices, orders, and alerts on WhatsApp from Odoo 20
problem: Teams chase customers on email and phone while invoices, deliveries, and payment updates sit unread in Odoo.
solution: WhatsApp Automation connects Odoo to WhatsApp Business providers, queues messages, and triggers notifications from sales, invoices, and deliveries.

features.title: Message Queue
features.text: Reliable outbound queue with retry and delivery status.

features.title: Automation Rules
features.text: Trigger WhatsApp on confirm, invoice, delivery, and custom events.

features.title: Templates
features.text: Reusable templates with placeholders for PDFs and links.

features.title: Provider Adapters
features.text: Meta, Twilio, 360Dialog, and extensible provider layer.

seo_keywords: Odoo 20, Odoo Community, WhatsApp Integration, WhatsApp Business API, invoice WhatsApp, sales automation
